Name: Emily Color Tweaks
Author: ebuaskew
Description:
I'm still pretty new to modding, but I've always wanted to touch up a few of the character portraits.... Especially Emily's. I love her design but the colors are a bit too blaring for me ;;

I've really enjoyed using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/32975490]lakoria[/url]'s sprite edit, so I made a matching dress for Emily's portrait as well! I've touched up the sprite colors to match the portrait which you can both find in the download file, but if you'd like to use lakoria's original edit, you can find it [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1970]here!

[/url][/u]You can choose between a red and a purple dress by typing either "red" or "purple" in the config file.

---

NOTE: I haven't updated the beach portraits yet, but I plan to soon!
